title: Repair worker status contract drift
objective: Stop repeated Swarm control validation failures caused by workers emitting undocumented worker-status values such as CLAIMING; make the worker lifecycle contract explicit, test the accepted transition vocabulary, and restore live control state without weakening fail-closed ownership validation.
acceptance: the supported worker-status vocabulary is explicitly documented where every Go worker reads it
worker registration and claim-time lifecycle states that the protocol requires validate without ad hoc control-state rewrites
unknown worker statuses still fail closed
core and hardening control-plane tests cover the worker-status contract
live swarm-control validation returns PASS after current malformed worker records are reconciled
notes: Emergency red-control recovery created from repeated exact-head Actions failures on worker records whose status vocabulary was not specified to workers. This is scheduler/control maintenance, not a product feature.
